library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(dbplyr)

readRenviron(".env")
con = dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(),
  host = Sys.getenv("SUPABASE_HOST"), port = Sys.getenv("SUPABASE_PORT"),
  dbname = Sys.getenv("SUPABASE_DB"), user = Sys.getenv("SUPABASE_USER"),
  password = Sys.getenv("SUPABASE_PASSWORD"))
dbListTables(con)

result = tbl(con, "flights") %>%
  filter(origin == "JFK", dest == "BOS") %>%
  group_by(carrier) %>%
  summarize(flights = n(), mean_delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  collect()

dbDisconnect(con)
code.sql:
SELECT `carrier`, COUNT(*) AS `flights`, AVG(`dep_delay`) AS `mean_delay`
FROM (
  SELECT `flights`.*
  FROM `flights`
  WHERE (`origin` = 'JFK') AND (`dest` = 'BOS')
) AS `q01`
GROUP BY `carrier`
